public class VariantOne {

        String[] firstLine = reader.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int b = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] data = reader.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(data[i]);
        }
        int[] diff = new int[n];
        int index = 0;

        int oddCount = a[0] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            if (evenCount == oddCount) {
                diff[index++] = Math.abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]);
            }
            if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount++;
            } else {
                oddCount++;
            }
        }
        Arrays.sort(diff, 0, index);
        long sum = 0;
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < index; i++) {
            if (diff[i] + sum <= b) {
                count++;
                sum += diff[i];
            }
        }
        writer.write(count + "\n");
        writer.flush();
    }
}
